title: Linie

description.en: A network operations dashboard template drawn like an engineering verification sheet.
description.zh: 以工程校核图为视觉语言的网络运维控制台模板。

subject: Satin teal-enamel drafting set square with a triangular opening and brushed-brass working edge

source.description: A network operations dashboard template drawn like an engineering verification sheet

subject.en: Teal enamel drafting set square with a brass working edge
subject.zh: 青绿珐琅制图三角尺，带黄铜工作边

description.en: One triangular set square at a product-photography angle, with a clean central opening and the complete silhouette inset inside the rounded presentation. Its floor shadow is independent.
description.zh: 一块三角尺以产品摄影角度完整呈现，中央开孔干净，整体轮廓留出圆角安全距离。地面投影独立保存。

description.en: Deep enamel carries the identity; a narrow brushed-brass working edge adds one crafted accent. Physical thickness, restrained highlights and machining grain keep the tool credible.
description.zh: 深青珐琅构成主体，细窄拉丝黄铜工作边提供唯一的工艺点缀。真实厚度、克制高光与加工细纹让工具保持可信。

description.en: Warm drafting paper holds one sparse right-angle construction, two reference rays, calibration ticks and three registration brackets. None of it enters transparent UI marks.
description.zh: 暖色制图纸上只有一组稀疏直角构造线、两条基准射线、校准刻线与三个定位括号，均不进入透明界面标记。

sizeNote.en: At 128/64 px the triangular opening and brass edge remain readable. At 32/24 px the silhouette still reads as a set square; at 16 px the enamel outline and opening carry the mark, while machining grain and the brass reflection recede.
sizeNote.zh: 128/64 px 保留三角开孔与黄铜边；32/24 px 轮廓仍能识别为三角尺；16 px 由珐琅外轮廓与开孔承担识别，加工细纹和黄铜反光自然退后。

goal.en: Start a large-scale network operations console from a working React template: a deterministic 1,248-host fleet, six operational panels, a closable sidebar and a read-only simulated companion, with no production systems connected.
goal.zh: 用一套可运行的 React 模板起步做大型网络运维控制台：1,248 台确定性主机、六个运维面板、可收起侧栏和只读模拟助手，不接入任何生产系统。

role.en: Strict application, view-model and Worker logic
role.zh: 严格模式的应用、视图模型与 Worker 逻辑

role.en: Six-panel atlas interface and workspace shell
role.zh: 六面板图谱界面与工作台外壳

role.en: Accessible standard controls with square drawing geometry
role.zh: 带方形制图几何的可访问标准控件

role.en: Lint and formatting with warnings rejected
role.zh: 拒绝告警的静态检查与格式化

role.en: Model, view-model, Worker and deployment-verification tests
role.zh: 模型、视图模型、Worker 与部署校验测试

role.en: Desktop and mobile journeys with axe accessibility checks
role.zh: 桌面与手机流程及 axe 无障碍检查

role.en: Static assets plus an anonymous liveness endpoint
role.zh: 静态资源托管与匿名存活端点

description.en: Pressed drafting-guide furrows, fine unnumbered ruler notches and crossing construction impressions form a quiet engineered paper field.
description.zh: 压印的制图导引槽、无数字的细密刻线与交叉构造痕构成一张克制的工程纸面。
